patthana15.57:1.1: savitakkaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.57:2.1: savitakkaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇiyeva. savicāraduka kusalattike nasavicāraduka nakusalattikaṃ
